description:
Your home screen, sorted by color. Find any app at a glance.
Your home screen, sorted by color.

Look for the red apps: your eyes have already found them. Chroma Launcher sorts every app by the color of its icon, so you find apps by color instead of reading names.

• Find apps at a glance. YouTube is red, WhatsApp is green, Facebook is blue: brands already taught you their colors.
• Always tidy. New apps drop into their place automatically, with nothing to arrange.
• Your color, your call. Pick another color from the icon, or any color at all.
• Pages, not folders. Everything starts on Main; move rarely used apps to Extra, or name your own pages.
• Make it yours. Circle, squircle, teardrop and more icon shapes, square or hexagon grid, joined icons, sizes and borders.
• Fast and private. Opens in a blink and works fully offline.
• Free and open source: gitlab.com/rcmz/chromalauncherreborn
